# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest version of Since Us gets security fixes. Please update before reporting a problem.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **don't** open a public issue for security problems.

Instead, report them privately:

- through [GitHub's private reporting](https://github.com/DerDieDasLian/sinceus/security/advisories/new), or
- by mail to [contact@sinceus.de](mailto:contact@sinceus.de?subject=Since%20Us%20security)

Please describe what you found, how to reproduce it and which version you used. You'll get an answer within a few days. Once a fix is released, the problem will be described in the release notes, and you'll be credited if you like.

## Good to know

Since Us stores all data on the device and has no server. The GitHub version only connects to GitHub to check for updates. Sync between phones uses encrypted files (AES-256-GCM) that only paired phones can open.
